The heater now holds its state inside a half-degree band either side of the target, and replaying last night's log gives 2 relay switches instead of 12.

On that log it comes on once at 04:26 (19.3°C) and goes off once at 04:40 (20.6°C), ignoring all the wobble around 20°C in between.

The band is `HYSTERESIS_C = 0.5`, directly under `TARGET_C` at the top of `greenhouse.py`. With the current values the heater switches on at 19.5°C or below and off at 20.5°C or above; a reading exactly on either threshold counts as reaching it.

The relay starts as off, so if the script starts up with the temperature already between 19.5 and 20.5, the heater stays off until it drops to 19.5.
